model: ROLEX Cosmograph Daytona 126506 (40 mm 950 platinum, ice-blue dial with brown sub-dial rings and baton indices, brown Cerachrom bezel with engraved tachymetre scale, three sub-dials, two screw-down chronograph pushers, platinum Oyster bracelet)
note: FOLLOWER of the Daytona 40 template (126500LN): same step / prep / kit preset (read-only), same camera, case, bezel rings, crown / pushers, hands and Oyster bracelet joints (all re-checked by overlay, see baseline). Per photo: ice-blue dial, brown ceramic bezel (the bezel ring geometry carries the photo; scale and numerals are texture), platinum parts come through the projected photo (no separate platinum material). Native 1920 x 2857 photo, 22.4625 px/mm, no texture scaling. Emissions: see steel / dial / hands blocks and BASELINE.md.

case.note: outline = contour of the photo silhouette between the lug rows (horn top y 910 = 22.93 mm, horn bottom y 1990 = 25.15 mm); the slab slopes toward the bracelet

bezel.note: bright chamfer bezel_in 16.10 .. insert_in 17.06 mm, ceramic ring to the ellipse ceramic_out (rx 19.67 mm, ry 19.38 mm, centre 0.37 mm lower than the flange), polished edge ring to the case flank ellipse (rx 20.0 mm); scale, numerals and reflections are the projected photo

hands.note: hands = picked photo outlines (trace.hands[name].outline_mm) as flat polygons: hour and minute sword hands (black facet and lume strip are photo), chronograph seconds needle with arrow head and paddle tail, the three sub-dial needles with their hub discs; emission = dial emission so the polygons blend into the printed dial

crown.note: fluted Rolex crown (the guards are in the case slab): flutes x 1405..1472 px, cap to 1496.5 px, axis 0.49 mm below the pivot, 16 coarse flutes

pushers.note: two screw-down pushers on radial axes through trace.pushers.origin_mm at +-28 deg: neck, fluted ring, narrower cylindrical cap (grooves are texture)

strap.note: strap.bracelet.columns lists the column kinds left to right; bounds_x_mm holds one boundary less; pieces_mm has top / bottom [y0, y1] chains per kind. An Oysterflex strap is columns ["strap"] with one z_strap and a short chain per side.

bracelet.note: Oyster bracelet, three columns (outer brushed, centre polished). Joint rows (px, 22.4625 px/mm, pivot (960, 1425)), read from 4x crops and column-mean brightness runs, top and bottom separately: outer top 770.5, end 684.2 (steps in the alpha silhouette and the brushed break); outer bottom 2159 / 2346 / 2467, end 2513.6 (silhouette steps); centre top 904.5 / 875.5 / 750 (the thin dark band that precedes each bright plate), end 682.0; centre bottom 2040.5 / 2243 / 2422 / 2496 (dark bands before the bright plates; the broad black bands inside a plate are reflections), end 2513.6. Column lines x 861.65 / 1058.05 (y 715), 860.76 / 1059.17 (y 810), 859.78 / 1060.1 (y 960), 859.97 / 1060.13 (y 2100), 860.38 / 1059.61 (y 2295), 861.68 / 1058.36 (y 2460), 862.1 / 1058.46 (y 2505): gradient maxima on 30-100 row bands. The centre column starts at 18 mm under the case. Outer link edges come from the alpha silhouette.

crystal.note: alpha-blended, not transmission: web viewers blur the dial behind transmission glass
